Karthika Masam is considered the most sacred month for devotees of both Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva. It is widely believed that lighting lamps and offering prayers with devotion during this month invites the blessings of the divine, dispelling ignorance and kindling the light of wisdom within people. This year, the grand festival of Karthika Deepotsavam is being hosted in Rajahmundry, serving as the venue for this celebrated event filled with devotion and spiritual fervor. Organized annually under the banner of ETV and Eenadu, the collective Karthika Deepotsavam is set to commence shortly, with all arrangements fully in place.

The Collector advised candidates to follow election guidelines and prescribed expenditure limits.
